DISTANCE.R1: All shots are taken at 25 meters from the firing line.
DISTANCE.R2: The distance is checked regularly to ensure fairness.

POSITION.R1: The shooting position is Bench Rest (seated with bipod and sandbags).
POSITION.R2: Rigid supports such as 'sleds' are prohibited.
POSITION.R3: Only soft supports like sandbags and bipods are allowed.
POSITION.EX1: Example: Correct position with bipod and rear bag.
POSITION.EX2: Example: Incorrect position with rigid fixed support.

TIRS.R1: Each shooter has 10 shots per round.
TIRS.R2: Any extra shots are invalid and not counted.

TEMPS.R1: Each round lasts 3 minutes starting from the first shot.
TEMPS.R2: The timer is controlled by the referee.
TEMPS.R3: The shooter must manage his shooting pace according to his strategy.
